g.text: Extended Data Figure 10b | A recurrent encoder-sensitive backbone is reused across factors and phases

text.style: fill: #556171; font: 6.35px 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Absolute top sets preserve global encoder sensitivity; factor-selective sets subtract each neuron's within-phase mean log effect across all 38 factors. Null sets preserve area × within-area training-rate-quintile composition. Whole-trial deletion is evaluated within each phase window; n=9 trials and weak factor-selective split-half reliability prohibit stable single-cell or causal claims.
